title: Use RLS for shared-schema tenant isolation

why_now: Shared-schema tenancy puts tenant isolation inside every query path.
RLS gives the database a backstop when application filters are missed.
why_not_yet: RLS policies need session identity plumbing, bypass-role review, tests, and operational debugging discipline.
triggers_for_next_stage: Review policy coverage for every tenant-scoped table and add plan checks for hot tenant filters.
